<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to,from,heading,body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ParamEntity "<!ELEMENT extra (#PCDATA)>">
  %ParamEntity;
]>
<note>
  <to>Tove</to>
  <from>Jani</from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>
  <body>Parameter entity validation test.</body>
  <extra>Extra content allowed by param entity.</extra>
</note>
